announcement.notice: Preview catalog — demo products, studios, and orders. LynxPay sandbox payments.

nav.menuDescription: Browse departments, studios, and search the SupplyHub preview catalog.

cart.emptyBody: Browse the catalog and add something made by an independent studio.
cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptySignedIn: Objects you add from the catalog appear here and stay with your account.
cart.emptyGuest: Objects you add from the catalog appear here. This cart is saved on this device for 30 days — sign in to keep it across devices.
cart.suspended: This account cannot use the cart while it is suspended.
cart.issue: That quantity is not available. Adjust the line and try again.
cart.guestNotice: This cart is saved on this device for 30 days.
cart.guestNoticeTail: to keep it with your account and check out.
cart.hasIssues: Some objects need attention before checkout. Remove them or adjust the quantity below.
cart.problemAction: Remove it or reduce the quantity to continue.
cart.onlyCustomers: Only customer accounts can place orders. Operational studio and administrator accounts cannot check out.
cart.phaseNote: Shipping and tax are not calculated in this phase. Checkout reserves stock, then LynxPay confirms payment in Tanzanian shillings.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Find an object by name, material, studio, or city. The catalog is small enough to browse from start to finish, too.
search.noResultsBody: Try a different word, or clear the filters to browse everything.
search.footerNote: Searches cover object names, materials, descriptions, studios, and locations.
search.noMatches: No matches. Press Enter to search the full catalog for “{query}”.

footer.blurb: A preview of a curated marketplace for independent studios. Every listing carries the name of the person or workshop that made it.

home.title: Objects with a maker's name on them
home.subtitle: Shop home, fashion, beauty and more from independent studios and verified sellers.
home.newArrivalsDescription: The latest objects added by independent studios.
home.newArrivalsEmpty: No new objects in this period
home.newArrivalsEmptyBody: Check back soon, or browse the full catalog.
home.whyProtectionBody: Funds are held until you confirm delivery.
home.whyTrackingBody: Watch your courier move on a real map.
home.whyVerifiedBody: Every seller is approved by the marketplace.
home.heroSubtitle: Shop home, fashion, beauty and more from independent studios and verified sellers — with the maker, materials and origin visible on every listing.
home.heroImageAlt: A seller working on a laptop at a sunlit desk, with a SupplyHub seller dashboard open
home.featuredDescription: Real products from the catalog, with prices, availability, and maker information.
home.spotlightFallback: {studio} is an approved studio with {count} {objects} in the current catalog.
home.benefitProvenanceBody: Every listing carries the studio, location, and maker behind the object.
home.benefitDetailBody: Materials, dimensions and care notes stay visible, not buried.
home.benefitDeliveryBody: Pickup or distance-based delivery, shown clearly before checkout.

products.title: All objects
products.intro: Every listing carries the name of the studio that made it.
products.catalogIntro: A considered edit from {count} independent studios. Filter by department or studio, then follow the maker's name on each listing.
products.noResultsBody: Try a different department or studio, clear the filters, or search the catalog for a material or maker.

product.returnsNote: Easy returns within the protection window.
product.soldOutTitle: This piece has found a home.
product.soldOutBody: The listing is no longer available. Explore related objects from the studio below.
product.checkoutNote: Checkout reserves stock and opens LynxPay payment in Tanzanian shillings.
product.relatedDescription: Related by department or studio. Every object has a maker, and every maker has more to see.
product.reviewCart: Review your cart and check out

vendor.studiosIntro: The independent workshops behind every object.
vendor.headline: Small workshops, named makers.
vendor.intro: Every object in the catalog comes from one of these independent studios. Each has a location, a discipline, and a story about how the work is made.
vendor.followObject: Follow an object back to its maker.
vendor.moreStudiosDescription: Each studio in the preview has its own discipline, location, and way of working.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.stkSent: STK push sent to your phone. Approve it to complete payment.
checkout.emptyDescription: Add an object from the catalog before checking out. Your delivery details are only requested at this step.
checkout.confirmIntro: Prices and stock are checked again on the server when you place the order. Your cart may be split into one order per studio.
checkout.unavailableNotice: Some objects in your cart are unavailable or priced differently.
checkout.deliveryNote: These details are stored with the order. Payment details are never collected here.
checkout.sandboxNote: LynxPay sandbox checkout: payment is collected in Tanzanian shillings on the next step. Shipping and tax are not calculated in this phase.
checkout.pickupBody: Collect the object directly from each studio. No delivery fee.
checkout.deliveryBody: Delivered to the address above. Price depends on distance.
checkout.locationUnsupported: This browser does not support location access.
checkout.locationDenied: Location access was denied or unavailable.
checkout.locationRequired: Use your location before placing a delivery order.
checkout.paymentNote: Payment is collected through LynxPay on the order page in Tanzanian shillings. The order holds its stock reservation for {minutes} minutes while you pay. Delivery is calculated when you choose delivery; tax is not calculated.
checkout.pinLocation: Pin your location on the map. Seller locations are shown below.
checkout.allowLocation: Allow location access to pin your delivery address on the map.
checkout.addItemForQuote: Add items to your cart to see per-studio delivery distances and prices.

auth.registryHeadline: Every object arrives with the name of the person who made it.
auth.registryBody: One account keeps your orders, saved studios, and vendor workspace together. No marketplace noise, just the record of what you bought and who made it.
auth.sessionNote: Sessions expire after seven days. SupplyHub never stores card details.
auth.name: Name
auth.phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +255 754 123 456. Buyers can add this later at checkout.
auth.buyProductsBody: Browse the marketplace and place orders.
auth.sellProductsBody: Continue to the seller application. An administrator must approve the store.
auth.signInIntroBody: Your orders, saved studios, and vendor workspace live behind one account.
auth.noticeReset: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
auth.noticeVerified: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
auth.noticeSignoutAll: You have been signed out on every device.
auth.rejectedNote: Studio application rejected? Sign in to review the decision and submit an appeal.
auth.unverifiedNote: Email not verified? Sign in, then request a new verification link from your account page.
auth.signUpIntroBody: Create an account to shop or sell. Sellers continue to a studio application for administrator review.
auth.forgotIntroBody: Enter the email on your account. If it matches, we will send a single-use link that expires in one hour.
auth.linkExpires: The link expires in one hour. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
auth.resetLinkSingleUse: Password reset links are single-use and expire after one hour.
auth.requestNewLinkNotice: Request a new link to continue.
auth.resetSignsOut: Resetting your password signs you out on every device.
auth.verifyLinkSingleUse: Verification links are single-use and expire after 24 hours.
auth.requestNewVerification: Request a new verification email from your account page.
auth.waitAndRetry: Wait a short while, then try the link again.
auth.rateLimited: Verification attempts are rate limited to protect accounts.
auth.confirmEmailBody: This confirms the address on your SupplyHub account. The link can only be used once.

studio.title: Seller studio
studio.overviewDescription: What needs your attention in the studio today.
studio.noOrders: No orders yet. Paid orders containing your objects will appear here.
studio.allReviewed: Everything in the catalog is reviewed.
studio.adjustInventory: Adjust inventory before the next order.
studio.stockHealthyNote: No published object is at 4 or fewer.
studio.finishProfileNote: Add your story, departments and pickup location.
studio.accountSettingsBefore: Email settings and account details live on your
studio.applicationStatusDescription: Your studio application and its review status are shown here. Selling tools open after approval.
studio.submittedNotice: Application submitted. A SupplyHub administrator will review it before your workspace opens.
studio.appealNotice: Your studio application was rejected. Review the decision and submit your appeal below.
studio.underReviewBody: An administrator reviews every studio before it can list objects. Nothing else is needed from you right now.
studio.notApprovedNotice: This studio application was not approved.
studio.whatNextBody: Applications cannot be resubmitted from this preview. Contact the SupplyHub team if you believe the decision was made in error.
studio.noReviewNote: No note was included with this decision.
studio.appealRejectionStands: Your appeal was reviewed and the rejection stands.
studio.suspendedBody: Listing, order, and account tools are unavailable while the studio is suspended. Contact the SupplyHub team for details.

admin.title: Marketplace administration
admin.overviewIntro: Counts reflect current database records. Paid or fulfilling includes orders paid, processing, shipped, or delivered.
admin.vendorsIntro: Review studio applications and open workspaces. Approving an application grants the owner the vendor role; every decision is recorded in the audit log.
admin.ordersIntro: {count} matching orders · customer and vendor status are shown separately.
admin.usersIntro: {count} matching accounts. Admin accounts are protected from suspension.
admin.productsIntro: Publish objects submitted by studios, return them with a note, or curate what appears in the featured edit. Every decision is recorded in the audit log.
admin.categoriesIntro: Departments organize the storefront navigation and category pages. Archiving a department hides it and its objects from the public catalog.
admin.paymentsIntro: Every confirmed LynxPay payment is checked against its order total and the commission ledger. Refunds reverse vendor earnings and platform commission in the same ratio.
admin.payoutsIntro: Vendor earnings come from the commission ledger, never from order totals typed by hand. Recording a payout reserves that balance until the transfer is marked paid and reconciled.

experience.title: Buy with confidence
experience.subtitle: Every purchase is covered end to end: protected payment, live courier tracking with a hand-over code, easy returns, verified reviews and a direct line to the studio.
experience.footnote: This experience runs on your device so you can try every protection feature safely. Real catalog prices and studios are used; payments are simulated and never charge an account.

shop.title: Build your order
shop.addItems: Add items to try the protected checkout.
shop.doneBody: Your payment is held in protection until you confirm delivery.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.empty: No orders yet. Place one from the Shop tab.
orders.handoverNote: The courier must enter this code to mark delivered.

protection.title: Protection & returns
protection.escrowBody: We hold your payment until you confirm the item arrived as described.

reviews.title: Verified-purchase reviews
reviews.gate: Reviews unlock after you confirm receipt of an order.

security.phoneBody: Let delivery couriers reach you reliably.
